name: SafeHarness
title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
summary_en: Turns obstacle-avoidance requirements into action choices during routing and contact, combining waypoint validation with replanning.
caveat_en: Report task success and collision avoidance separately; neither constitutes a formal safety guarantee.

name: HALTER
title: From Rollout to Reset: A Graph-Based Harness for Autonomous Long-Horizon Manipulation Evaluation
summary_en: Builds scene graphs and composes atomic reset skills for automatic scoring, reset planning, and reset verification in long-horizon evaluation.
caveat_en: Reset accuracy differs from policy task success; the evaluation initial-state distribution must also be recorded.

name: GPT-Policy
title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
summary_en: A context compiler retains task-relevant visual transitions; a VLM proposes robot tool actions that a constrained controller checks and executes.
caveat_en: Context adaptation is not parameter learning; distinguish human-video configurations from references that include actions.

name: MaP-WAM
title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
summary_en: Uses long histories for planning, compresses them into segment-level language and visual guidance, and predicts action chunks and execution progress with an action model.
caveat_en: A fixed executor context does not mean that planner cost stays constant as history grows.

name: FARM
title: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
summary_en: Freezes the VLA-JEPA predictive backbone and trains only a lightweight readout, producing failure scores from internal states and aggregating risk over observed history.
caveat_en: The reported approximately 0.23 ms covers detection overhead after states are available; failure detection is not a recovery policy. Evaluate unseen-task performance separately.

name: Harness Robotic OS
title: Harness Robotic OS: A Unified Embodied-Agent Runtime for Closed-Loop Quadruped Inspection
summary_en: Organizes quadruped inspection skills, shared context, hierarchical memory, and controlled candidate updates into a unified runtime.
caveat_en: System deployment metrics alone do not establish causal benefits from continual self-evolution.

name: Show-Harness
title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
summary_en: A VLM emits discrete semantic action units that an embodiment-specific interpreter deterministically converts into local actions, with GUI support for collecting demonstrations.
caveat_en: Record zero-shot frontier-model configurations separately from fine-tuned smaller-model configurations.

name: EvoHarnessBench
title: EvoHarnessBench: Can Your Agents Keep Pace with an Evolving Harness?
summary_en: Expands an external harness in stages and separately evaluates retention of existing capabilities and adaptation to new ones.
caveat_en: Forgetting in general-purpose agents motivates robotics hypotheses; it is not a robotics result.

name: HarnessDev
title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
summary_en: Evaluates the capability and cost of building and improving executable harnesses, including held-out tasks and transfer across models.
caveat_en: The evidence concerns general-purpose software agents; transfer to physical robots still requires experiments.

name: HarnessEvolve
title: HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution
summary_en: Uses reference trajectories for failure attribution and screens harness updates through quality and performance gates to reduce regressions.
caveat_en: Reference trajectories use answer information; robotics settings must prevent leakage of privileged information.

name: PonderPounce
title: PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control
summary_en: Maintains an episode in the native MLLM context and asynchronously guides an action model through cognition tokens and token age.
caveat_en: A jointly trained interface is not a plug-and-play frozen VLA; distinguish refresh, inference, and playback frequencies.

name: Zetta
title: Zetta $ζ$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
summary_en: Evolves code critics and recovery skills around a frozen base policy, separating the timescales of actions, rollouts, and update validation.
caveat_en: High scores depend on the rollout budget used in the paper; action-rate governance does not imply large-model inference at the action rate.

name: SHAPER
title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
summary_en: Keeps parameters frozen and uses environment rollouts to jointly optimize reusable skills and a context-code harness.
caveat_en: Check that target-environment adaptation data is separated from generalization tests.

name: PhyAgentOS
title: PhyAgentOS: A Self-Evolving Operating System for Embodied Agents with Decoupled Cognitive Planning and Physical Execution
summary_en: Uses sessions to organize scheduling, evidence, acceptance checks, and memory, decoupling cognition from physical execution through inspectable state records.
caveat_en: Execution termination and semantic task success must be verified separately.

name: Zero2Skill
title: Zero2Skill: Bootstrapping Robot Skills through Autonomous Data Collection, Training, and Deployment
summary_en: Collects data, verifies outcomes, and resets autonomously; requests human help only after exhausting a retry budget, then parses language corrections into Corrective Memory for reuse across rounds.
caveat_en: Reduced human effort does not necessarily mean reduced elapsed time; distinguish collection success, verification accuracy, and trained-policy performance.

name: Harness VLA
title: Harness VLA: Steering Frozen VLAs into Reliable Manipulation Primitives via Memory-Guided Agents
summary_en: Uses a frozen VLA as a retryable contact primitive, combining analytical tools with task and global memory to extend manipulation capabilities.
caveat_en: This does not imply that the entire robot system requires no training; results must specify the backbone and rollout budget.

name: ASPIRE
title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
summary_en: Diagnoses failures using fine-grained multimodal execution records, searches for repair programs, and accumulates validated experience as skills.
caveat_en: Verify transfer across tasks and embodiments; distinguish one-off repairs from sustained benefits.

name: Harness Engineering for Physical AI
title: Harness Engineering for Physical AI: Robot Middleware Is the Harness Layer
summary_en: Proposes output constraints, resource isolation, and fallback mechanisms across control, computation, and communication paths.
caveat_en: This is a position paper and protocol proposal, not a validated deployment standard.

name: HARBOR
title: HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Breaks simulation RL engineering into executable stages and automates training pipelines through persistent artifacts, checkpoints, and experience reuse.
caveat_en: Improving a training pipeline is not online control; distinguish engineering cost from policy performance.

name: Robo-Cortex
title: Robo-Cortex: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent via Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory and Autonomous Knowledge Induction
summary_en: Distills navigation trajectories into reusable heuristics, combining short-term reflection, long-term principle memory, and Imagine-then-Verify planning.
caveat_en: The primary evidence concerns navigation and embodied question answering; it does not directly establish benefits for contact manipulation.

name: Learning While Deploying
title: Learning While Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
summary_en: Pools deployment experience from multiple robots, continually updates a generalist VLA using DIVL and QAM, and redeploys it.
caveat_en: The paper studies 16 robots and 8 tasks; this does not establish effectiveness at larger scales or in heterogeneous fleets.

name: CaP-X
title: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary_en: Provides environments and evaluation for robot coding agents, studying tool abstractions, test-time compute, and RL with verifiable rewards.
caveat_en: Human-designed tool priors, perception access, and interaction budgets determine whether comparisons are fair.

name: RoboClaw
title: RoboClaw: An Agentic Framework for Scalable Long-Horizon Robotic Tasks
summary_en: Combines forward manipulation and reverse recovery into a self-resetting loop, using a unified VLM controller to organize collection, learning, and deployment.
caveat_en: Task success and autonomous reset success are separate metrics.

name: RoboMME
title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
summary_en: Evaluates temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory in robotics, comparing 14 memory-augmented configurations.
caveat_en: Aggregate averages are insufficient across different memory tasks; report per-task performance and oracle conditions.

name: TwinRL
title: TwinRL: Digital Twin-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Real-World Robotic Manipulation
summary_en: Reduces online learning cost through SFT support-set expansion, digital-twin RL warm-up, and targeted real-world exploration.
caveat_en: Include digital-twin construction in total cost instead of comparing only minutes of real-world interaction.

name: PLanAR
title: PLanAR: Planning-Language-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Robot Manipulation
summary_en: Constrains reasoning with object predicates, action preconditions and postconditions, and symbolic plans, checking execution effects step by step and replanning.
caveat_en: Earlier drafts were titled AgenticLab; v4 changes the positioning, so it should no longer be described only as a benchmark.

name: StreamVLA
title: StreamVLA: Breaking the Reason-Act Cycle via Completion-State Gating
summary_en: Generates textual and visual completion states at subtask transitions, while locking intent and continuously producing actions during stable execution.
caveat_en: Check whether both normal progress and execution failures reliably trigger replanning.

name: LaST0
title: LaST$_{0}$: Latent Spatio-Temporal Chain-of-Thought for Robotic Vision-Language-Action Model
summary_en: Connects a low-frequency reasoning expert to a high-frequency action expert through latent reasoning that incorporates visual dynamics, 3D structure, and proprioception.
caveat_en: Compare latent-reasoning benefits against baselines with matched parameter counts and compute budgets.

name: Arcadia
title: Arcadia: Toward a Full-Lifecycle Framework for Embodied Lifelong Learning
summary_en: Connects autonomous exploration, scene reconstruction, shared embodied representations, and simulation updates driven by real-world feedback.
caveat_en: The lifecycle framework implementation and the causal contribution of each stage still require full-text verification.

name: ViReSkill
title: ViReSkill: Vision-Grounded Replanning with Skill Memory for LLM-Based Planning in Lifelong Robot Learning
summary_en: Replans from visual observations after failures and stores successful plans in skill memory for later reuse.
caveat_en: Evaluate gains from repeated-scene replay separately from cross-task transfer.

name: Fast-in-Slow
title: Fast-in-Slow: A Dual-System Foundation Model Unifying Fast Manipulation within Slow Reasoning
summary_en: Embeds a fast execution module within a slow reasoning system through partially shared parameters, asynchronous frequencies, and heterogeneous inputs.
caveat_en: The reported 117.7 Hz uses chunk=8; it is not the number of independent VLM inferences per second.

name: OneTwoVLA
title: OneTwoVLA: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Adaptive Reasoning
summary_en: A unified model switches between reasoning and action as needed, co-trained on robot data and synthetic reasoning data.
caveat_en: Record switching triggers, end-to-end latency, and recovery from unexpected events.

name: RoboOS
title: RoboOS: A Hierarchical Embodied Framework for Cross-Embodiment and Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary_en: Organizes tasks and error correction across embodiments using an embodied brain, a modular skill library, and real-time shared memory.
caveat_en: State synchronization alone is not evidence that shared experience improves a policy.

name: REMAC
title: REMAC: Self-Reflective and Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary_en: Combines precondition and postcondition checks, self-reflection, and dynamic planning for long-horizon multi-robot tasks.
caveat_en: Self-evolving plans do not imply updates to policy weights.

name: MALMM
title: MALMM: Multi-Agent Large Language Models for Zero-Shot Robotics Manipulation
summary_en: Assigns task planning, control-code generation, and process supervision to separate agents, using stepwise feedback to handle failures.
caveat_en: This is a division of labor among agents within one system; it does not automatically imply collaboration among multiple robots.

name: RoCo
title: RoCo: Dialectic Multi-Robot Collaboration with Large Language Models
summary_en: Multiple robots use dialogue to produce task decompositions and waypoints, then check feasibility using environment feedback and motion planning.
caveat_en: Record multi-robot collaboration separately from shared learning across robots.
